# AudioPhysx

> Build more expressive game audio with less MetaSound wiring.

- [AudioPhysx](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/readme.md): AudioPhysx
- [Getting started](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/getting-started/readme.md): New to AudioPhysx? Follow these pages in order. You can reach a first playable result without using acoustic path components or writing C++.
- [MetaSound node reference](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/metasound/readme.md): AudioPhysx contains 23 native MetaSound nodes in the development source reviewed for this documentation.
- [Blueprint integration](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/blueprint/readme.md): AudioPhysx provides functions and components for connecting game-world information to audio. These features operate outside the MetaSound audio-render loop.
- [Examples and recipes](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/examples/readme.md): These are small, task-oriented walkthroughs meant to show a useful result before you explore the complete node catalogue.
- [Help and support](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/support/readme.md): Troubleshooting — the fastest checks for common problems.
- [Sound Cue support — planned](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/sound-cue/readme.md): AudioPhysx's existing source reviewed for these pages implements MetaSound nodes and Blueprint helpers. Custom Sound Cue USoundNode classes are not part of this source package.

## Getting started

- [Requirements](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/getting-started/requirements.md): The documentation currently targets the AudioPhysx UE5.8.4 development source. The final Fab package may have a different verified version matrix; that will be published on Compatibility.
- [Installing AudioPhysx](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/getting-started/installation.md): The exact installation method depends on whether you received the finished Fab code plugin or a private development source build.
- [Your first AudioPhysx MetaSound](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/getting-started/first-metasound.md): In this walkthrough you'll make three recordings play in order using AP: Sequence Wave Player. Each sound starts once the previous sound has finished—no manual delay values.
- [Understanding inputs, outputs and completion](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/getting-started/signals-and-completion.md): Trigger pins describe moments: start playback, stop playback, release a held effect or announce completion.
- [Quick setup checklist](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/getting-started/checklist.md): AudioPhysx plugin enabled and visible in Edit → Plugins.

## MetaSound nodes

- [Playback](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/metasound/playback.md): Playback nodes select and play recordings. Most expose Out Mono and, where implemented, playback completion events.
- [Acoustics](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/metasound/acoustics.md): These tools shape audio behaviour using physically inspired processing, author-controlled parameters or timing logic.
- [Propagation](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/metasound/propagation.md): These tools shape audio behaviour using physically inspired processing, author-controlled parameters or timing logic.
- [QoL](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/metasound/qol.md): These tools shape audio behaviour using physically inspired processing, author-controlled parameters or timing logic.
- [MetaSound interfaces and game-provided data](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/metasound/interfaces.md): AudioPhysx can publish acoustic parameter values from Blueprint/world systems to a MetaSound graph. Use the interfaces and names included with your installed plugin build, rather than creating independent duplicate parameters with similar names.

### Nodes

#### Playback

- [Playback node reference](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/metasound/nodes/playback/readme.md): AP: Sequence Wave Player — Play a set of recordings in a fixed order, starting each wave after the previous one finishes.
- [AP: Distance Wave Player](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/metasound/nodes/playback/distance-wave-player.md): MetaSound category: AudioPhysx → Playback Source contract: Unreal Engine 5.8.4 development source
- [AP: Flyby Wave Player](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/metasound/nodes/playback/flyby-wave-player.md): MetaSound category: AudioPhysx → Playback Source contract: Unreal Engine 5.8.4 development source
- [AP: Layered Wave Player](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/metasound/nodes/playback/layered-wave-player.md): MetaSound category: AudioPhysx → Playback Source contract: Unreal Engine 5.8.4 development source
- [AP: PhysMat Wave Player](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/metasound/nodes/playback/physmat-wave-player.md): MetaSound category: AudioPhysx → Playback Source contract: Unreal Engine 5.8.4 development source
- [AP: Random Sequence Wave Player](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/metasound/nodes/playback/random-sequence-wave-player.md): MetaSound category: AudioPhysx → Playback Source contract: Unreal Engine 5.8.4 development source
- [AP: Random Wave Player](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/metasound/nodes/playback/random-wave-player.md): MetaSound category: AudioPhysx → Playback Source contract: Unreal Engine 5.8.4 development source
- [AP: Sequence Wave Player](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/metasound/nodes/playback/sequence-wave-player.md): MetaSound category: AudioPhysx → Playback Source contract: Unreal Engine 5.8.4 development source
- [AP: Shuffle-Bag Wave Player](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/metasound/nodes/playback/shuffle-bag-wave-player.md): MetaSound category: AudioPhysx → Playback Source contract: Unreal Engine 5.8.4 development source
- [AP: Start Loop End Player](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/metasound/nodes/playback/start-loop-end.md): MetaSound category: AudioPhysx → Playback Source contract: Unreal Engine 5.8.4 development source
- [AP: Surface Wave Player](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/metasound/nodes/playback/surface-wave-player.md): MetaSound category: AudioPhysx → Playback Source contract: Unreal Engine 5.8.4 development source

#### Acoustics

- [Acoustics node reference](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/metasound/nodes/acoustics/readme.md): AP: Acoustic Paths — Apply the selected acoustic route: propagation delay and three-band loss from the game-thread path solver.
- [AP: Acoustic Paths](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/metasound/nodes/acoustics/acoustic-paths.md): MetaSound category: AudioPhysx → Acoustics Source contract: Unreal Engine 5.8.4 development source
- [AP: Early Reflections](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/metasound/nodes/acoustics/early-reflections.md): MetaSound category: AudioPhysx → Acoustics Source contract: Unreal Engine 5.8.4 development source
- [AP: Impact Dynamics](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/metasound/nodes/acoustics/impact-dynamics.md): MetaSound category: AudioPhysx → Acoustics Source contract: Unreal Engine 5.8.4 development source
- [AP: Material Transmission](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/metasound/nodes/acoustics/material-transmission.md): MetaSound category: AudioPhysx → Acoustics Source contract: Unreal Engine 5.8.4 development source
- [AP: Source Directivity](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/metasound/nodes/acoustics/source-directivity.md): MetaSound category: AudioPhysx → Acoustics Source contract: Unreal Engine 5.8.4 development source

#### Propagation

- [Propagation node reference](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/metasound/nodes/propagation/readme.md): AP: Atmosphere Absorption — Change high-frequency absorption based on travel distance and air conditions.
- [AP: Atmosphere Absorption](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/metasound/nodes/propagation/atmosphere-absorption.md): MetaSound category: AudioPhysx → Propagation Source contract: Unreal Engine 5.8.4 development source
- [AP: Distance Delay](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/metasound/nodes/propagation/distance-delay.md): MetaSound category: AudioPhysx → Propagation Source contract: Unreal Engine 5.8.4 development source
- [AP: Doppler Ratio](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/metasound/nodes/propagation/doppler-ratio.md): MetaSound category: AudioPhysx → Propagation Source contract: Unreal Engine 5.8.4 development source
- [AP: Dynamic Propagation](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/metasound/nodes/propagation/dynamic-propagation.md): MetaSound category: AudioPhysx → Propagation Source contract: Unreal Engine 5.8.4 development source

#### QoL

- [QoL node reference](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/metasound/nodes/qol/readme.md): AP: Distance Switch (Dynamic) — Route a trigger to one of several expandable distance bands.
- [AP: Distance Switch (Dynamic)](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/metasound/nodes/qol/distance-switch.md): MetaSound category: AudioPhysx → QoL Source contract: Unreal Engine 5.8.4 development source
- [AP: Float Smoother](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/metasound/nodes/qol/float-smoother.md): MetaSound category: AudioPhysx → QoL Source contract: Unreal Engine 5.8.4 development source
- [AP: Trigger Cooldown](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/metasound/nodes/qol/trigger-cooldown.md): MetaSound category: AudioPhysx → QoL Source contract: Unreal Engine 5.8.4 development source
- [AP: Trigger Probability](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/metasound/nodes/qol/trigger-probability.md): MetaSound category: AudioPhysx → QoL Source contract: Unreal Engine 5.8.4 development source

## Blueprint integration

- [Projectile flyby integration](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/blueprint/flyby.md): You can trigger a close-pass flyby using a path segment, without using Chaos or spawning special AudioPhysx projectile actors.
- [Blueprint playback helpers](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/blueprint/playback-helpers.md): The public UAPAudioBlueprintLibrary exposes these callable operations in the current source:
- [Acoustic path queries](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/blueprint/acoustic-paths.md): AP: Query Acoustic Path is exposed by UAPAcousticPathLibrary. It evaluates an acoustic path for supplied source and listener world positions, with an optional source actor.
- [Acoustic components](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/blueprint/components.md): AudioPhysx includes several components for representing environmental acoustics in a level.
- [Acoustic Physical Materials and project settings](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/blueprint/materials-and-settings.md): UAPAcousticPhysicalMaterial extends Unreal's UPhysicalMaterial with acoustic information including:

## Examples and recipes

- [Randomized one-shot sounds](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/examples/randomized-one-shot.md): Tools used: AP: Random Wave Player
- [Automatic weapon with RPM](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/examples/automatic-weapon.md): Tools used: AP: Start Loop End Player
- [Multi-stage sound variation](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/examples/random-sequence.md): Tools used: AP: Random Sequence Wave Player
- [Material-dependent footsteps](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/examples/material-footsteps.md): Tools used: AP: PhysMat Wave Player or AP: Surface Wave Player
- [Projectile near-miss flyby](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/examples/projectile-flyby.md): Tools used: AP: Flyby Wave Player + AP: Play Projectile Flyby
- [Basic acoustic obstruction](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/examples/acoustic-obstruction.md): Tools used: AP: Material Transmission or AP: Acoustic Paths

## Support

- [Troubleshooting](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/support/troubleshooting.md): Check Edit → Plugins and verify the plugin is enabled.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/support/faq.md): No. It extends MetaSounds and game-audio workflows. Unreal's own attenuation, concurrency, mixer, audio components and Sound Cues remain part of a typical project.
- [Engine and platform compatibility](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/support/compatibility.md): These pages were generated against the AudioPhysx UE5.8.4 development source available on 27 November 2026. They do not establish that a final Fab package has passed packaged-game verification.
- [Changelog](https://DaSypher.github.io/AudioPhysx-Docs/support/changelog.md): Documentation baseline based on the AudioPhysx UE5.8.4 Start Loop End RPM source package.
